lens: job relevance, construct discipline, decision claims, and responsible evaluation
strengths: The page evaluates an operational evidence-to-action loop and makes no claim to measure candidate quality, fit, personality, culture, potential, engagement, or acceptance probability.
A dedicated FAQ states that recruiter attention may be ordered around current dependencies while people are never converted into a fit or quality score.
The working example distinguishes observed evidence, proposed interpretation, correction, confirmation, approval, and observed outcome.
Unsupported evidence produces No supported change rather than a substituted inference or hidden composite score.
The release evidence uses deterministic interaction, sitemap, accessibility, and route checks instead of presenting a decorative overall person score.
